children: DeFi researcher Ignas said on X that Bankless co-founder David Hoffman sold his ETH and rotated into some of the strongest-performing tokens, including LIT and ZEC, while NEAR also performed well and VVV lagged the broader market. According to Odaily, Ignas said active crypto investors aim to outperform BTC and ETH, even as the market was filled with fear, uncertainty and doubt and ETH was near its bottom.
Earlier, Bankless co-founder David Hoffman said in June that he had sold all of his ETH and bought VVV, NEAR, ZEC, HYPE and LIT.

title: DeFi Researcher Ignas Says David Hoffman Shifted From ETH Into Top-Performing Tokens
